title: I Built An AI Brain For My Whole Business (Claude Code)
description:
Comment "BRAIN" and I'll send you the full setup.

My AI brain connects my entire personal business into one place. It wires together my website analytics, my Supabase database, and my Obsidian notes so Claude Code can see everything about what I'm building.

The real value is being able to open a new chat and ask anything about my business. Claude pulls from my brain, my database, and my dashboard, then gives me real advice based on my actual work, not generic AI answers.

I built this for myself first. Now you can build it too.

#claudecode #ai
